title: The Lord Will Be King Over All the Earth

questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:1 (ESV): "Behold, a day is coming for the Lord, when the spoil taken from you will be divided in your midst."

questions.question: For I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem to...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:2 (ESV): "For I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem to battle,"

questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:2 (ESV): "but the rest of the people shall not be cut off from the city."

questions.question: Then the Lord will go out and fight against those nations as when he fights on a day of...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:3 (ESV): "Then the Lord will go out and fight against those nations as when he fights on a day of battle."

questions.question: On that day his feet shall stand on the Mount of...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:4 (ESV): "On that day his feet shall stand on the Mount of Olives that lies before Jerusalem on the east,"

questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:4 (ESV): "and the Mount of Olives shall be split in two from east to west by a very wide valley,"

questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:4 (ESV): "so that one half of the Mount shall move northward, and the other half southward."

questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:5 (ESV): "Then the Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with him."

questions.question: On that day living waters shall flow out from Jerusalem, half of them to the eastern sea and half of them to the western sea. It shall continue in...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:8 (ESV): "It shall continue in summer as in winter."

questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:9 (ESV): "On that day the Lord will be one and his name one."

questions.question: What plague will the Lord strike the peoples with who wage war against Jerusalem?
options: Their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet
questions.correctAnswer: Their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:12 (ESV): "their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths."

questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:16 (ESV): "and to keep the Feast of Booths."

key_verse_text: And the Lord will be king over all the earth. On that day the Lord will be one and his name one.
